description: This file contains unit tests for the PurgeProcessedCommandsTasklet class, which is responsible for purging processed command events older than a specified number of days in the Apache Fineract platform. It uses JUnit 5 and Mockito for testing, verifying that the purge logic behaves correctly and handles exceptions gracefully.

classes.name: PurgeProcessedCommandsTaskletTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PurgeProcessedCommandsTasklet, testing its behavior for command purging operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting thread-local context for tenant and action context, and instantiates the class under test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread-local context after each test to prevent interference.

methods.name: givenEventsForPurgeWhenTaskExecutionThenEventsPurgeForDaysCriteria
methods.description: Tests that the purge executes correctly when scheduled, verifying the deletion with proper date criteria.

methods.name: givenEventsForPurgeWhenExceptionOccursThenJobExecutionFinishesSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests that the purge job completes successfully even when an exception occurs during the deletion process.
